jobs:
  platform:
    name: Portable checks (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-26-intel, windows-latest]
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install pinned native inspection toolchain
        run: python scripts/release/sevenzip.py install
      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm ci
      - name: Frontend static checks
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        working-directory: frontend
        run: |
          npm run format:check
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
      - name: Audit frontend dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npx --yes audit-ci --config audit-ci.json

      - name: Validate public help and MCP
        run: |
          npm ci --prefix tools/help --ignore-scripts
          node --test tools/help/*.test.mjs

      - name: Audit help dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: npm audit --prefix tools/help --audit-level=high

      - name: Frontend unit tests and coverage
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm run test:coverage

      - name: Frontend unit tests (macOS and Windows)
        if: runner.os != 'Linux'
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm test

      - name: Seal browser unit line map from this run
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: node scripts/ci/unit-coverage-artifact.mjs seal frontend/coverage/lcov.info target/ui-unit-coverage

      - name: Upload browser unit line map
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ui-unit-coverage-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: target/ui-unit-coverage/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload frontend coverage
        if: always() && matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: frontend-coverage-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: frontend/coverage/
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Delivery and AI eval smoke
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: |
          make eval-smoke
          node --test scripts/test-ai-eval.mjs

      - name: Install Rust for diagnostic Cargo fixtures
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Native release inspection regression
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y nsis

      - name: Verify native NSIS payload equivalence
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: python scripts/release/test_native_nsis.py -v

      - name: Diagnostic and release gate regressions (all platforms)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node scripts/check-repository-hygiene.mjs
          node --test scripts/diagnostics/*.test.mjs

      - name: Build retention safeguards (all platforms)
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_build_retention.py -v

      - name: Publish frontend coverage
        if: >-
          matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' &&
          !(github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
            github.base_ref == 'dev' &&
            github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'dependabot[bot]')
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@303a32d7a59b442fa8d48b6a1cc6825c09c847a5 # v7.1.1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: frontend/coverage/lcov.info
          name: frontend-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          fail_ci_if_error: true

  source:
    name: Source and supply-chain checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      # Source/policy scanners have identical inputs on each OS; run them once.
      # Gitleaks owns the full-history secret scan in its independent workflow.
      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - name: Rust formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check
      - name: Install source scanners
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2.88.1
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny,cargo-machete,typos-cli,shellcheck
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: '1.25'
          cache: false
      - name: Install workflow scanner
        run: |
          go install github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@v1.7.12
          echo "$(go env GOPATH)/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Source and supply-chain policy
        run: |
          typos
          cargo deny check
          cargo machete
          shellcheck --severity=warning scripts/*.sh scripts/release/*.sh .claude/hooks/*.sh hooks/*
          actionlint

name: UI E2E

# Browser end-to-end tests for the React UI (Playwright + Chromium, headless). Drives the real
# app with a mocked Tauri IPC layer — guards the rendering/wiring that black-screened v0.1.0.
# The Rust multi-process backend E2E lives separately (`make e2e`).
on:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  push:
    branches: ["main", "dev"]
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      extended:
        description: Run extended theme, locale, resize and memory scenarios
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' }}

jobs:
  health:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/check-health.yml
    secrets: inherit

  linux:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ui-shards.yml
    with:
      operating_systems: '["ubuntu-24.04"]'

  desktop:
    # Admit the desktop browser burst after portable unit/static checks finish.
    needs: health
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ui-shards.yml
    with:
      operating_systems: '["macos-latest","windows-latest"]'

  coverage:
    # This existing name is required by branch protection. It now certifies
    # successful shards plus their complete current-source coverage upload.
    name: Full Linux UI regression
    needs: [linux, health]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - name: Require all browser shards
        working-directory: .
        env:
          BASELINE: ${{ needs.linux.result }}
          UNIT_COVERAGE: ${{ needs.health.result }}
        run: |
          test "$BASELINE" = success
          test "$UNIT_COVERAGE" = success
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

name: Sanitizers

# Memory-safety / leak guardrail: runs the pure-Rust core test suite under
# AddressSanitizer (ASan, which embeds LeakSanitizer) so a genuine leak or
# use-after-free in the protocol core fails the build.
#
# Scope: ONLY `mesh-talk-core --lib` (the UI-free core). The Tauri app links
# GTK/WebKit C libraries whose internals trip ASan with false positives we can't
# fix from here, so the app is deliberately excluded.
#
# Run on PRs targeting main so branch protection can require this memory-safety
# check before merge. Run again on main so the README badge reflects the merged
# code; keep the weekly run to catch toolchain and dependency drift.
# ASan needs the nightly toolchain + `-Z build-std` (a full std rebuild).
on:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1" # Mondays 06:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

# Read-only: just checks out and runs the test suite under the sanitizer.

  contents: read

The successful jobs show substantial execution cost as well as setup cost: the sampled ASan partition has a median of about 35 minutes, macOS coverage 22 minutes and UI shards 11 minutes. These are mixed historical samples, so they aren’t a controlled baseline yet.

The repository’s validation planner is blocked by pre-existing Entire configuration and hook changes. I’ll leave those user-owned changes untouched.
